title: Hotel Check-In Problem
description: The learner arrives at a hotel to check in, but there's an issue with the reservation that must be resolved. The whole conversation is conducted in Japanese.
objectives: Explain the problem clearly when the reservation isn't found or is wrong
Negotiate a solution (different room, price, or timing)
possible_events: The reservation is under a different date than expected
The room type booked is unavailable and an upgrade or downgrade is offered
The learner is asked to explain what was originally booked, requiring past tense
success_criteria: Learner reaches a resolution with the receptionist

difficulty_modifiers.description: Receptionist offers a straightforward fix quickly and uses simpler phrasing
Receptionist adds a complication, e.g. an extra fee dispute, requiring negotiation
